Name: WhoisFreaks
Author: WhoisFreaks - support@whoisfreaks.com
Description:
WhoisFreaks commercial threat intelligence and newly registered domain (NRD) monitoring for Microsoft Sentinel. This Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) solution ingests threat feeds and NRD data from the [WhoisFreaks API](https://whoisfreaks.com/) and stores the results in custom Log Analytics tables for hunting, detection, and investigation. For API details and subscription information, see the [WhoisFreaks API documentation](https://whoisfreaks.com/).

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Azure Monitor HTTP Data Collector API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/data-collector-api)
b. [Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/)

**Dependencies and prerequisites:**
- [WhoisFreaks API](https://whoisfreaks.com/)
- Microsoft Sentinel workspace and Data Collection Endpoint / Rule resources
- A valid API key with entitlement to the requested feeds

This solution may incur ingestion or API usage charges depending on your subscription, selected feeds, and retention settings.
